caption: The image is a plain, hand-drawn pattern schematic in black ink on beige or off-white paper. The drawing consists of multiple outlined shapes representing pattern pieces for garment construction, each labeled with letters and numbers. The largest pieces are rectangular and occupy the lower central area of the drawing. There are several irregularly shaped pieces, including curving and angled edges, situated in the upper left, lower left, and upper right corners. Near the top center, there is a small rectangular piece labeled "E" and a triangular piece containing internal dashed lines labeled "CENTER FRONT." Across the pattern pieces, there are various labels such as "CENTER BACK," "FACING," and other text, alongside numbers indicating measurements or piece identifications. The composition is tightly arranged within a rectangular border, with the elements distributed to efficiently use the available space. A scale is present near the bottom right corner. The overall color of the image stems from the black ink on the pale background, and there are no filled-in or shaded regions, just clean contour lines and text for technical reference.
title: Dress (Pattern)
